Recipe: Creamy Chicken and Potato Skillet with Bacon Ingredients: 6 small potatoes 2 chicken breasts 6 rashers of bacon 1 tsp piri piri seasoning ×2 2 tsp cajun seasoning ×2 1/2 tsp turmeric ×2 2 tbsp oil ×2 200ml double cream Grated cheese (cheddar or mozzarella) Fresh parsley (for garnish) Instructions: Prepare Potatoes and Chicken: Cut 6 small potatoes into small pieces. Season potatoes with 1 tsp piri piri seasoning, 2 tsp cajun seasoning, and 1/2 tsp turmeric. Mix well. Cut 2 chicken breasts into small pieces. Season chicken with 1 tsp piri piri seasoning, 2 tsp cajun seasoning,2tbsp oil and 1/2 tsp turmeric. Mix well. Fry Bacon: Fry 6 rashers of bacon until brown and crispy. Remove bacon from the pan and cut into small pieces. Cook Potatoes: In the same pan used for bacon, add 2 tsp oil. Add seasoned potatoes and fry on low heat for around 15 minutes, covering with a lid to help cook faster. Cook Chicken: In another pan, fry seasoned chicken for around 7 minutes on medium-low heat. Combine Chicken and Cream: Once chicken is cooked, add 200ml double cream to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, allowing flavors to meld. Final Assembly: Add the cooked bacon to the chicken and cream mixture. Mix well. Place the fried potatoes on top of the chicken mixture. Cover with grated cheese (cheddar or mozzarella). Cover the pan with a lid and let the cheese melt. Sprinkle fresh parsley and crispy bacon on top for garnish. Tips and Tricks: Use small potatoes for faster cooking and better texture. Cutting the chicken into small pieces ensures even cooking and allows for better flavor absorption. Cooking potatoes on low heat with a lid helps them cook evenly and retain moisture. For a richer flavor, use double cream instead of single cream. Experiment with different cheese varieties for varied flavor profiles. Garnish with fresh parsley for a pop of color and added freshness. Adjust seasoning according to personal preference for spice level. Serve hot and enjoy as a comforting meal any time of the day! Frequently Asked Questions: Q: Can I use single cream instead of double cream? A: While single cream can be used as a substitute, double cream provides a richer and creamier texture to the dish. Q: Can I use other seasoning blends? A: Feel free to experiment with different seasoning blends to customize the flavor according to your preference. Q: How can I make this dish healthier? A: Consider using lean turkey bacon or turkey sausage as a healthier alternative to traditional bacon. Additionally, using less cheese or opting for a lower-fat cheese can reduce the calorie and fat content of the dish. Q: Can I make this dish ahead of time? A: While it's best enjoyed fresh, you can prepare components of the dish in advance and assemble it just before serving.
